provenance: Condensed independent block reviews from the initial synthetic renderer audit based on 6c55434 plus cumulative local UI work. Historical review; current-main integration checks are documented separately.

classification.variant: album collection browse and album detail

findings.observation: The visible catalog gives no cue that Command-click (or Command+Space on a focused row) selects songs. The table's aria-label documents Command-click, but that instruction is not visible in either capture. The selection toolbar only appears after selection.

classification.state: disconnected connection form; connected library chooser
classification.profile: light desktop macOS web renderer, synthetic bridge; captures at 1280x900 and 960x700

findings.observation: The server field is type=url and its example uses https://, but the visible form gives no indication that only HTTP/HTTPS addresses without embedded credentials, query, or fragment are accepted. Those restrictions are enforced later in serverAddress; a syntactically valid URL using another scheme can therefore pass browser validation and fail only after Connect.

wide DJ create/edit form with three configuration modes

classification.state: selected song; light desktop renderer at 1280×900, scale 1

findings.observation: Expanded lyrics are exposed as a dialog while the main workspace is made inert and hidden from accessibility APIs, but aria-modal is absent and the player remains outside the hidden region. Source does not show a focus trap. The implementation therefore leaves the expanded view's modal versus nonmodal interaction contract unclear to assistive technology.

classification.profile: light desktop macOS web renderer at 1x; synthetic renderer bridge

findings.observation: The resize separator is keyboard-focusable and handles ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End, but its styles suppress outlines and the global focus-visible rule explicitly excludes .sidebar-resize-handle. No focus-visible replacement is defined. A keyboard user therefore has no visible indication when focus reaches the resize control.

classification.state: selected, available audio, not yet heard; desktop light

classification.variant: Settings / Playback subsection disclosure with preference form
classification.state: expanded and collapsed captures; light theme; desktop density; macOS web renderer

findings.observation: In both paused captures, upcoming rows visibly expose a reorder grip, while the remove action is visually absent. Source styles reveal the remove IconButton only on row hover or keyboard focus; its accessible label and tooltip are present in source.
The source chooser disables unchecked sources at 20 selected, but the source group does not explain the limit or why those choices became unavailable.

classification.variant: settings / sources management with editor dialog

findings.observation: The RSS / Atom field uses native type=url validation, while the save path also rejects non-HTTP(S) schemes and credential-bearing URLs. Those additional rules are only surfaced by the mutation error after submit.

At the 960 px capture, the sort-direction control wraps onto a second row, separated from the Sort select it modifies; Refresh is also alone at the far right of that row. At 1280 px the direction control stays beside Sort. The 960 px toolbar crop and DOM evidence report a 496 px toolbar width and 181.4 px height, compared with 804 px and 122 px at 1280 px. Source uses a wrapping flex row with the sort selector and direction button as separate children and gives Refresh auto left margin.

classification.variant: Settings / Playback subsection disclosure with transition timing and preview
classification.state: expanded and collapsed captures; light theme; desktop density; macOS web renderer

findings.observation: NewsTransitionPreview is keyed to JSON.stringify(settings). Any timing or mode edit remounts the preview, resetting its native disclosure to closed while also stopping playback.
